part_name: OZ51x Dual-RX Housing — Vertical Stack, Fable 5 Extra Edition
description: Production-refined redesign of the vertical dual-RX housing by Claude (Fable 5 extra). Same verified interfaces as oz51x-dual-rx-housing-vertical v1 (bays, studs, bosses, SMA, fiber, SC/APC, DE-9, corridors, keep-outs, lip ring) with an extruded-profile edge language, integral wall-mount flanges, bay ventilation/drainage louvers, recessed SC adapter pockets, harness tie-down anchors, entry chamfers on every pilot, a deterministic DE-9 jackscrew capture slot at the parting line, and engraved panel labels oriented for the vertical attitude. Geometry built by this directory's model.py (the redesigned family builder).
notes: FABLE 5 EXTRA REDESIGN of oz51x-dual-rx-housing-vertical v1. All module, SMA, mounting, harness, fiber, DE-9, and corridor interfaces are inherited unchanged; only edge treatment, mounting, ventilation, serviceability, and finish features were added. See DESIGN.md in this directory for the full change list and assumptions.

MOUNTING: two integral flanges (top + bottom in the finished attitude), flush with the mount face, 4x slotted holes for M4/#8 pan-head screws. Slots run along the depth to absorb hole-position tolerance. Gusseted roots print support-free with the tray in its canonical (mount-face-down) print orientation.

EDGES: canonical vertical edges R2.5; mount-side long edges R1.2 (limited by the SC adapter flange sitting 0.24 mm above the floor plane on the back panel); cover perimeter chamfered 1.2; matched 0.6 reveal chamfers make the parting line an intentional V-groove.

VENTILATION/DRAINAGE: downward-facing slots in the bottom face (intake + weep, nothing can fall in), low intake + high exhaust louver groups in the service cover over the bays. Slots are 2.0 mm — probe-safe. The fiber plenum and top face are deliberately unvented.

DE-9 SEAM: the connector flange (30.8 mm) spans the lid parting line across the 32.7 mm finished width — it is surface-mounted (no recess possible), and the top jackscrew hole is opened into a deliberate capture slot closed by the cover edge. v1 left a 0.12 mm ligament there that would break unpredictably when printed.

SC ADAPTERS: flanges seat in 0.8 mm recessed pockets (locates the adapter, flush look); M2 pilots keep 2.2 mm engagement. Retention remains the flange screws, as documented in the family requirements.
LABELS: engraved RF / TTL beside each SMA, RX identity centered on the front face, maker mark on the cover — all oriented to read horizontally in the finished vertical attitude.
RF receiver is the upper bay, TTL receiver the lower bay. Verify the real TTL module and ordered panel hardware before fabrication (unchanged family assumption).
